capture.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA Corporation, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070/PCIe/SSE2, OpenGL ES 3.2)
capture.source: Chronological original PNG browser samples with recorded capture timestamps. First six seconds only. Full originals retained locally.

output.conversion: Original capture timing, whole frame, Lanczos resize and GIF color quantization. No overlays, retouching, invented motion or application/camera changes. Resize/palette conversion is lossy.

scope: Documentation only. Application and deployed image unchanged. Prior static banners retained as historical.
